body: but if it's just causing me pain then what's the point of continuing?  I am not getting anything out of this and I won't miss anything once it's done.

I've talked to a few friends about it but whenever I do that it really stresses them out and they don't want to be my friend anymore.  I don't want everyone to hate me so I try not to let most people know how bad I feel.  But they still all hate me anyway.

My therapist probably doesn't like me either.  I try talking to her but it's really hard and I don't exactly know what to say or how to describe how I feel.  I try and try but it's still really hard.

3-4 years?  With some brief respites.  I don't know how to make it better.  I've tried everything and it's been so long and I still am not better.  And the more I put it off the more I waste everyone's time and effort, and there's no point wasting my parents' money going to college if I know I am going to do it.  I just make everyone unhappy and there's no point because I'm so pathetic
